svg.title: HyperGrok: a Hyperliquid trading desk for Grok Bot
svg.desc: Your trading desk, fully staffed. An isometric trading floor: a ticket moves from the Desk Lead through the analysts and the Risk Manager, waits for your approval, then the Execution Trader sends it once to Hyperliquid and the Trade Reviewer records it.
svg.text: HYPERLIQUID TRADING DESK FOR GROK BOT
